description.value: The Nelson Public Library is a well-established community library in the heart of Nelson, serving residents and visitors with an extensive physical and digital collection including books, audiobooks, DVDs, and online databases. Open to anyone for on-site use, it offers a welcoming space to learn, study, and relax, with free access to computers and wireless internet. The library sits on the traditional territory of the Sinixt, Ktunaxa, and Syilx peoples and has been a pillar of the community for over 125 years.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and corroborates OSM contact details (phone, address, email) exactly. The About Us page confirms public access to computers, internet, and wireless services for all visitors, which supports the OSM tag internet_access=wlan and allows Wi-Fi to be confirmed as true. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, showers, or any bike-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Required criteria (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) could not be confirmed from website content — an in-person visit or direct inquiry is recommended to verify.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A publicly accessible community library in central Nelson offering confirmed free Wi-Fi to all visitors; a legitimate rest and connectivity stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.

blurb: Nelson's public library in the heritage downtown core.
